data.name: SlugFormat
data.value: '{PropertyName}' must be lower-case letters and digits separated by single hyphens.

data.name: SortByNotAllowed
data.value: '{PropertyName}' must be one of: {Fields}.
data.comment: Paged lists: sortBy outside the whitelist of the endpoint.

data.name: SortDirInvalid
data.value: '{PropertyName}' must be '{Ascending}' or '{Descending}'.

data.name: PhoneCharacters
data.value: '{PropertyName}' may only contain digits, spaces and + - ( ).

data.name: ItemsTooMany
data.value: '{PropertyName}' must contain at most {MaxItems} items.

data.name: ItemsContainNull
data.value: '{PropertyName}' must not contain null items.

data.name: ItemsDuplicateProduct
data.value: '{PropertyName}' must not contain the same product more than once.

data.name: DateRangeInverted
data.value: '{PropertyName}' must not be earlier than '{From}'.
data.comment: List filters from/to; {From} is the field name of "from".

data.name: ExternalOrderIdTooLong
data.value: '{PropertyName}' must be at most {MaxLength} characters.

data.name: SkuFormat
data.value: '{PropertyName}' must be at most {MaxLength} characters of A-Z, 0-9, '.', '_' or '-', starting with a letter or digit (case-insensitive).

data.name: RoleUnknown
data.value: '{PropertyName}' must be one of: {Roles}.

data.name: EmailInvalid
data.value: The e-mail address is not valid or contains characters that are not allowed.
data.comment: User e-mail rejected by Identity (format or characters).

data.name: ProductNotFound
data.value: Product '{ProductId}' does not exist.
data.comment: A referenced product does not exist (order line, stock import line).

data.name: CustomerNotFound
data.value: Customer '{CustomerId}' does not exist.
data.comment: The customer of an order does not exist.

data.name: PasswordTooShort
data.value: Passwords must be at least {Length} characters.

data.name: PasswordRequiresDigit
data.value: Passwords must have at least one digit ('0'-'9').

data.name: PasswordRequiresLower
data.value: Passwords must have at least one lowercase ('a'-'z').

data.name: PasswordRequiresUpper
data.value: Passwords must have at least one uppercase ('A'-'Z').

data.name: PasswordRequiresNonAlphanumeric
data.value: Passwords must have at least one non alphanumeric character.

data.name: PasswordRequiresUniqueChars
data.value: Passwords must use at least {UniqueChars} different characters.

data.name: ExternalIdRequired
data.value: Enter '{PropertyName}' or '{ExternalSku}'.
data.comment: Channel product mapping: at least one external identifier; {ExternalSku} is the field name of the external SKU.
